title: 부재선고등에관한특별조치법시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:22151:20100504:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum to the Enforcement Decree of the Electronic Government Act <Presidential Decree No. 22151, May 4, 2010>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on May 5, 2010.

Articles 2 and 3
Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (88) Omitted.
(89) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Special Act on Declarations of Absence, etc. shall be amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 2 (2), "Article 21 (1) of the Act on Promotion of Electronic Processing of Administrative Affairs, etc. for the Implementation of Electronic Government" shall be replaced with "Article 36 (1) of the Electronic Government Act".
(90) through (192) Omitted.
